links.outcome: FAITA-Mental Health crisis management domain score for OCD Coach chatbot
links.effect: Framework identified gaps in acute crisis management for the generative AI OCD tool; no numeric scores reported in the abstract.
links.quote: suggesting that the framework effectively identifies key strengths and gaps in AI-driven mental health tools, particularly in areas such as credibility, user experience, and acute crisis management.

unlisted_practices: Rating AI mental health tools with a structured framework (FAITA-Mental Health) covering credibility, user experience, crisis management, user agency, health equity, and transparency

screen.reason: The paper empirically applies an evaluation framework (FAITA-Mental Health) to evaluate a publicly available generative AI tool (OCD Coach on the ChatGPT store) regarding safety, crisis management, credibility, and equity.
